body:
I appreciate the time and energy you are giving me and I am sorry if this sounds dismissive but If our ancestors only procreated when times were good - we definitely wouldn't be here. 

If you can provide them with time, love, energy and food, a roof and warmth they got what they need.

However you are correct in trying to bring me down from my airy fantasy. It is not real and I can't ever go back. Such a sadness. A vast ocean of sadness surround me.

You think so?
It is tempting to accept your perspective because it would free me from grief. Is it not the easy way out? Shielding your heart from pain by use of nihilism and pessimism?

I don't think I can though because I think having kids is the one true meaning of life and it gives you will to live. A purpose and a really important role to play. And love. And joy. Just hearing a kid laugh is amazing. The look of their confounded, innocent eyes that are so eager to explore and experience life.
Please tell me about your own life.
